hero.eyebrow: Built for your kind of shop
hero.subtitle: A boutique, a home bakery, and a jewelry maker don't run their shop the same way. Pick what you sell below to see the problem it usually causes, and how Stallio handles it.

boutiques.label: Clothing Boutiques
boutiques.pain: Buyers ask the same “what sizes are left?” question on every single post, and older pieces get buried within a day.
boutiques.fix: A live catalog with sizes and stock per item, so buyers check themselves and nothing gets buried.

points.p1: Sizes and stock shown per product
points.p2: Older pieces stay browsable, not buried

bakers.label: Home Bakers
bakers.pain: Orders live across WhatsApp chats and a paper notebook, so deadlines and delivery dates get missed on busy weekends.
bakers.fix: One dashboard listing every order with its date and status, checked in one glance each morning.

points.p1: Every order in one list, not six chats
points.p2: Mark paid, baked, and out for delivery
points.p3: Export the week's orders in one click

bakers.ctaAs: Start free as a home baker

skincare.label: Skincare Brands
skincare.pain: A feed of product photos with prices in the caption doesn't give a first-time visitor enough confidence to buy.
skincare.fix: A proper storefront with categories and stock status that reads as a real brand, not just posts.
skincare.ctaAs: Start free as a skincare brand

jewelry.label: Jewelry Makers
jewelry.pain: Custom requests get buried in comments and DMs, so pending customizations are easy to lose track of.
jewelry.fix: Manual orders and requests logged straight into the dashboard, so nothing sits in a comment thread.

points.p1: Add manual or custom phone orders
points.p3: Update stock the moment a piece sells

jewelry.ctaAs: Start free as a jewelry maker

thrift.label: Thrift Resellers
thrift.pain: Every new drop means reposting each item again and answering the same price and size questions from scratch.
thrift.fix: One link per drop. Update stock in the dashboard and it reflects instantly, sold-out marks itself.

points.p1: One link to share per drop, not per item
points.p3: Delivery and coupons in one place

thrift.ctaAs: Start free as a thrift reseller

crafts.label: Handmade Crafts
crafts.pain: Buyers only ever see your most recent post, so older pieces in your range go completely unseen.
crafts.fix: A full catalog that's always browsable, so nothing depends on how recently it was posted.

points.p3: Share one link across every platform

crafts.ctaAs: Start free as a craft seller
